s: Seder tepillat musap beyachid ubo t"v seipim: ap al pi shebbeshabbatot veyamim tobim adam mitpallel sheba berakot, dehaynu shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uqedushshat hayyom baemtza, abal berosh hashshana tiqqenu chakamim lehitpallel bemusap shel shene hayyamim tesha berakot, dehaynu shebbebirkat qedushshat hayyom kolel pesuqe malkuyyot kede leqabbel alenu ol malkut shamayim, veachar kak omerim birkat zikronot, veomer bah pesuqe zikronot kede sheyyaaleh zikronenu lepanayv letoba, veal yede ma — al yede shopar, lepikak omer achar kak birkat shoparot veomer pesuqe shoparot:

Ap al pi shebbishar yemot hashshana en hashsheliach tzibbur motzi bitpillato ella et mi sheeno baqi abal habbaqi eno yotze bitpillat hashsheliach tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d, abal bemusap shel rosh hashshana ap habbaqi yotze bitpillat hashsheliach tzibbur, lepi shehen berakot arukkot, vehu sheyyihyeh bebet hakkeneset im hashsheliach tzibbur veyishma mimmennu hattepilla merosh vead sop. Umi shehu anus veeno yakol labo lebet hakkeneset kegon am shebbassadot vezaqen vecholeh — poter hashsheliach tzibbur ap al pi shello shama mimmennu hattepilla:

Veakshav shehashsheliach tzibbur mapsiq bepiyyutim beemtza hattepilla — en adam yotze bitpillat hashsheliach tzibbur, apillu im hu lo shama happiyyutim, mikkol maqom hu shoheh kede ligmor et kol hattepilla vetzarik lachazor larosh kemo shennitbaer besiman s"h, vaapillu im eno shoheh kol kak, mikkol maqom lekattechilla asur lipsoq apillu meat battepilla:

Vaapillu bemaqom sheen omerim piyyutim beemtza hattepilla — ap al pi ken mutab sheyyitpallel kol echad veechad beatzmo, ki mi sheyyirtzeh latzet bitpillat hashsheliach tzibbur tzarik sheyyekavven lekol mah sheomer sheliach tzibbur, veim chisser apillu teba achat shello shama otah mehashsheliach tzibbur — lo yatza, veen kol adam yakol laamod bazeh, lepikak nahagu kol yisrael lehitpallel tepillat musap tesha berakot belachash techilla, vegam hashsheliach tzibbur yitpallel immahem kede lehasdir tepillato kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d:

Tzarik lehazkir pesuqe qorbenot hammusapim bekol tepillot shel musap, ben shel shabbat ben shel rosh chodesh ben shel yom tob ben shel rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, kede shettaaleh lanu hazkaratan bimqom haqrabatam. Veim amar "naaseh venaqrib lepaneka kemo shekkatabta alenu betorateka" — yatza, veshub en tzarik lomar miqraot hammusapin. Lepikak nohagin bisparad sheen omerim pesuqe hammusapin ella beshabbat verosh chodesh shergilin bahem velo yabou litot, abal bishar hammoadim en omerim pesuqe hammusapin shemma yabou litot al yede kak vetitbalbel tepillatam. Abal bimdinot ellu en chosheshin lekak venohagin lomar pesuqe hammusapin apillu beyom tob, ella sheen omerim pesuqe musap rosh chodesh berosh hashshana, lepi shedday bemah sheomerim "millebad olat hachodesh vego'", shebbazeh niklelu kol haolot shel musap rosh chodesh, ukede lehazkir gam hassair shehu chattat omerim "ushene seirim lekapper", veken omerim "et musepe yom hazzikkaron" leshon rabbim, kede liklol gam musap shel rosh chodesh shenniqra zikkaron kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"b. Veap beyom sheni sheeno rosh chodesh ap al pi ken omerim "et musepe veku' ushene seirim lekapper", kede shello yezalzelu beyom sheni meachar sheyyedeu sheyyom sheni hu sheni bachodesh veeno rosh hashshana:

Velama en nohagin lehazkir rosh chodesh beperush berosh hashshana? Kede shello yomru yom sheni shel rosh chodesh iqqar kemo bishar rosh chodesh veyimnu mimmennu hammoadot, dekevan sheyyazkiru rosh chodesh gam beyom sheni mittaam shennitbaer — yomru sherosh chodesh shene yamim, veod learbeb hassatan shello yeda shehayyom hu rosh chodesh tishre (velo yabo leqatreg), lepikak en omerim parashat "uberashe chodshekem" qodem "ezehu":

En pochatin mishshelosha pesuqe malkuyyot umishshelosha pesuqe zikronot umishshelosha pesuqe shoparot, pasuq echad shel tora vehashsheni shel ketubim vehashshelishi shel nebiim, veim pachat — lo yatza. Abal lekattechilla tzarik sheyyomar asara pesuqim shel malkuyyot vaasara shel zikronot vaasara shel shoparot keneged asara maamarot shebbahen nibra haolam, shelosha pesuqim harishonim shel tora, ushelosha pesuqim shel ketubim, ushelosha haacharonim shel nebiim, umesayyem bepasuq echad shel tora, veim siyyem benabi, sheamar arbaa pesuqim shel nebiim — yatza:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkebar hitchil lomar pasuq echad shel malkuyyot o shel zikronot o shel shoparot, az tzarik lehazkir kol haasara pesuqim, abal im lo hitchil adayin beshum pasuq, im hu rotzeh eno tzarik lehazkir kelal happesuqim, ella omer "uleoleme ad timlok bekabod kakkatub betorateka, veken katub bedibre qodsheka, veken neemar al yede abadeka hannebiim, eloqenu veloqe abotenu melok al kol haolam kullo veku'", veken bezikronot veken beshoparot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bayyamim harishonim, abal bizman hazzeh asur laasot ken lekattechilla, lepi shekkebar qibbelu kol yisrael alehem choba lomar kol haasara pesuqim veen leshannot:
En omerim lo bemalkuyyot velo bezikronot velo beshoparot pesuqim sheyyesh bahen puranuyyot shel yisrael, abal omerim pesuqim sheyyesh bahem puranuyyot shel nokrim:
En omerim pasuq zikronot shel yachid, kegon "zokra li elohay letoba", "zokreni Hashem birtzon ammeka":

"Shema yisrael Hashem elohenu Hashem echad" hu oleh leminyan hammalkuyyot, demillat echad hu inyan malkut, kelomar shehu yachid umeyuchad veen domeh lo umalkuto bakkol mashala, ulepikak anu mashlimin bo hammalkuyyot kede lesayyem beshel tora:

Terua hare hu keshoparot, kegon "yom terua yihyeh lakem" oleh leminyan hashshoparot. Veken teqia hu keshoparot, kegon "uteqatem bachatzotzerot vego', veap al pi shekkatub bo "chatzotzerot" — en bekak kelum, kevan sheyyesh bo leshon teqia oleh leminyan shoparot, ulepikak anu mesayyemin bo hashshoparot kede lesayyem beshel tora. Yesh medaqdeqim lomar "vaaqedat yitzchaq lezaro shel yaaqob hayyom tizkor", deim yomar "lezaro tizkor" yihyeh gam esav biklal. Veyesh omerim sheen leshannot hannuscha hayshana veap al pi sheomerim "lezaro tizkor" en esav biklal zeh, shehare neemar "leka ulezaraka etten et kol haaratzot hael", uleesav lo nittan, mikkelal sheeno nechshab mizzaro shel yitzchaq kelal. Usebara harishona hu iqqar, mishshum debitpillat yamim noraim yesh lanu leparesh beinyan shello yehe shum sapeq bebaqqashatenu, kemo shennitbaer besiman tqp"b ayyen sham:

Lo yitpallel adam beyachid tepillat musap berosh hashshana ad achar shalosh shaot al hayyom, hoil vehu omer malkuyyot zikronot veshoparot yesh lo lachosh shemma yeayyenu bemaasayv vetiddacheh tepillato, shebbashshaot hallalu en haqqadosh baruk hu oseh lipnim mishshurat haddin, lepi sheoseq battora shenniqra emet, abal achar shalosh shaot hu dan et kol haolam kullo, vekevan sheroeh sheen haolam yakol laamod baddin niknas immahem lipnim mishshurat haddin velo tiddacheh tepillato:

Abal musapin shel kol hashshana, veken shacharit apillu shel rosh hashshana, hoil veenan ella shibcho shel haqqadosh baruk hu vesippure maaseh haqqorbanot — ap im yitpallel beyachid lo yeayyenu bemaasayv. Veken tepillat shacharit shel chol ap al pi shemmebaqqesh bah tzerakayv veyesh lachosh shemma yeayyenu bemaasayv, mikkol maqom hoil shemmin hassetam yesh tzibbur echad shemmitpalelim beshaa shehu mitpallel, shehare zemannah babboqer — tequbbal tepillato im tepillat harabbim, sheen haqqadosh baruk hu moes bitpillat harabbim leolam, shenneemar "hen el kabbir lo yimas". Abal bitpillat hammusap hoil uzemannah kol hayyom veyesh maqdimin lehitpallel veyesh meacharin — yesh lo lachosh shemma beshaa shehu mitpallel en mitpalelim tepilla zo shum tzibbur baolam vetiddacheh tepillato. Ulepikak yesh lizzaher baqqayitz shello lehitpallel shacharit shel chol beshaa rishona, dibvadday en hatztzibbur mitpalelim beotah shaa bizman hazzeh, veken bachorep lo yeacher leachar shette shaot al hayyom, dibvadday kebar hitpalelu kol hammeqomot, vetzarik hayyachid lizzaher shello lehitpallel bashshaa hashshelishit. Veken yizzaher hayyachid shello yitqa teqiat mitzva ad achar shalosh shaot al hayyom, mittaam shennitbaer:
Yesh lomar "veen leparesh ellum shemeka", abal lo yomar "veen perush ku'", ki yesh perush leellum shemo:
